hints.title: Fixed window size
hints.body: Every anagram has the same length as `pattern`, so only windows of that size matter.

hints.title: Slide the window
hints.body: Add the entering character and remove the leaving character.

hints.title: Compare counts
hints.body: A window is valid when its frequency table equals the pattern's table.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if len(pattern) > len(source): return []
need = counts of pattern
window = counts of the first len(pattern) characters
if window == need: record 0
for right from len(pattern) to len(source)-1:
    add source[right]
    remove source[right - len(pattern)]
    if window == need: record right - len(pattern) + 1
return indices
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
